notes.title: Major changes to some games, 18+ content will be released as DLC for free
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388611/2058ff94b8196c69e68c7b824cf32ab90ef11bef.png[/img]

We thought about it for a long time
We plan to launch future games directly at 12+ or 15+, and 18+ content will be released as DLC for free
Because we will always receive comments saying "I thought it was a Hentai game but it turned out not to be"
In fact, we're a little bothered.
We don’t focus on pornography, pornography is just an add-on
It’s similar to the fact that although there are pornographic elements, it’s just a snack, not the main course.
And we also know that this is not good for people who come to play for pornography.
So this approach may be good for everyone
Thank you for your support and understanding
We will continue to improve service quality
============================================
announcement
This game will undergo all content changes in the future
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2266000/_R18Ver
Equivalent to redoing everything in this game
This will be a plot game with cosmic horror x pure love x Roguelike
We will also remove the AI ​​drawings and replace them with hand drawings
Sorry for the inconvenience and we hope to see you in a better way!

notes.title: Regarding the SFW version of Ghost Girl Lasling and the next plan
notes.notes:
First, thank you all for accompanying us through 2023
We will launch more games with rich and in-depth plots.

Next, let’s explain the relevant plans and work
About Ghost Girl Lasling
The SFW version, CGSscontent, and some plots are different from another version but don’t worry, we will put the differences in the free DLC of the NSFW version so you don’t have to buy it again
However, some DLC cannot be free due to cost issues, sorry.

====================================
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36388611/3eafc3f9ab97ee59f8d1ebe65f3db963284c9c6d.png[/img]

About Tentacles Party With Nuns
This is the project we are mainly producing, a cosmic horror NSFW visual novel, that contains intense elements such as non-consensual sexual intercourse, Lovecraftian horror, and depictions of cruelty.

The playtime is 6~7H, maybe more.

◆What kind of story is this?

This is an ensemble cast story with many elements

Based on the religious environment of the old European era at the beginning of the 20th century(1917), it extends the suspense and tells the story of love.

Contains elements of occultism, cosmic horror, slight creepy, etc.

It will also focus on exploring the delicate and complex emotions between the main characters.

There have R18 plots, but the overall focus is still on the main drama and adventures between characters.
◆Game content:

Multiple localizations

Fully voiced characters, including passers-by (Japanese)

Many hand-drawn animations

The basic CG of 200+

Over 30 original soundtracks

3 original singing theme songs that fit the plot.

We are materializing the magic book in the game!(B5, 80pages, notebook)
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36388611/2d8d1873db1997855f7103f1bb5927453fbb17be.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36388611/ff1b2c80eb5a219341247d845aeedb45a74b17a5.png[/img]

There are also figures of the main characters!(In development)

(In addition to Chibi, SFW, and NSFW versions are also expected to be launched in the future, made by Dreamcatcher Factory)
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36388611/6ce98bece18835df4e1591958328f85fde9130b5.png[/img]

Follow us and have more fun!

notes.title: Game Content Update Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36388611/42365f910128f3238473159dcfa3ec120cc70087.png[/img]


In order to enhance the player experience, in addition to adding new content to the base game, we will also be adding animations and graphics in the upcoming DLC, which may cause a slight delay in the release date. 

After many days of hard work, we hope to present the new release in a better and more complete form to everyone. 

Thank you for your patience and support.

※Regarding the Arabic version 

Due to limitations in the Unity engine plugins currently used in the game, the special text mode (Right To Left) for Arabic cannot be implemented. 

Therefore, in order to ensure a smooth gaming experience for Arabic players, we will be switching to another game engine that supports RTL, and this porting process may take some time. 

We will also do our best to improve quality and efficiency. 

Additionally, the new engine may render graphics and special effects slightly differently than Unity, and we will do our best to overcome these challenges and provide a better overall experience. 

Thank you again for your support and patience:)
